moves.declaration: def supportedPart (n d : ℕ) : ℕ
moves.source_block:
def supportedPart (n d : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p => p ∣ d), p ^ n.factorization p

moves.declaration: def coprimePart (n d : ℕ) : ℕ
moves.source_block:
def coprimePart (n d : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p => ¬p ∣ d), p ^ n.factorization p

moves.declaration: theorem supportedPart_pos (n d : ℕ) : 0 < supportedPart n d
moves.source_block:
theorem supportedPart_pos (n d : ℕ) : 0 < supportedPart n d := by
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro p hp
  exact pow_ne_zero _ (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1).ne_zero

moves.declaration:
theorem supportedPart_mul_coprimePart {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℕ) :
    supportedPart n d * coprimePart n d = n
moves.source_block:
theorem supportedPart_mul_coprimePart {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℕ) :
    supportedPart n d * coprimePart n d = n := by
  rw [supportedPart, coprimePart, Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not]
  exact (Nat.prod_primeFactors_pow_factorization (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)).symm

moves.declaration:
theorem supportedPart_dvd {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℕ) :
    supportedPart n d ∣ n
moves.source_block:
theorem supportedPart_dvd {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℕ) :
    supportedPart n d ∣ n :=
  ⟨coprimePart n d, (supportedPart_mul_coprimePart hn d).symm⟩

moves.declaration:
theorem prime_dvd_supportedPart {n d p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hps : p ∣ supportedPart n d) : p ∣ d
moves.source_block:
theorem prime_dvd_supportedPart {n d p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hps : p ∣ supportedPart n d) : p ∣ d := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := (hp.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff _).mp hps
  obtain ⟨hqn, hqd⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
  have heq : p = q :=
    (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqn)).mp
      (hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hpq)
  exact heq ▸ hqd

moves.declaration:
theorem prime_dvd_coprimePart_not_dvd {n d p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpt : p ∣ coprimePart n d) : ¬p ∣ d
moves.source_block:
theorem prime_dvd_coprimePart_not_dvd {n d p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpt : p ∣ coprimePart n d) : ¬p ∣ d := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := (hp.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff _).mp hpt
  obtain ⟨hqn, hqd⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
  have heq : p = q :=
    (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqn)).mp
      (hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hpq)
  exact heq ▸ hqd

moves.declaration: theorem coprimePart_coprime (n d : ℕ) : (coprimePart n d).Coprime d
moves.source_block:
theorem coprimePart_coprime (n d : ℕ) : (coprimePart n d).Coprime d := by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpt, hpd⟩ := Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.mp h
  exact prime_dvd_coprimePart_not_dvd hp hpt hpd

moves.declaration:
theorem coprime_of_prime_support {u d s : ℕ} (hu : u.Coprime d)
    (hs : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ s → p ∣ d) : u.Coprime s
moves.source_block:
theorem coprime_of_prime_support {u d s : ℕ} (hu : u.Coprime d)
    (hs : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ s → p ∣ d) : u.Coprime s := by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpu, hps⟩ := Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.mp h
  exact (Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.mpr ⟨p, hp, hpu, hs p hp hps⟩) hu

moves.declaration: def CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequencyWindow (H : ℕ) : Finset ℤ
abbrev Inner := ℕ × ℤ
moves.source_block: abbrev Inner := ℕ × ℤ

moves.declaration: def fixedUnit (A : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) : Prop
moves.source_block: def fixedUnit (A : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (t : ℕ) : Prop := t.Coprime A ∧ t.Coprime a.natAbs

moves.declaration: def atomCoeff (lambda : ℕ → ℂ) (omega : ℤ → ℂ) (u : Inner) : ℂ
moves.source_block: def atomCoeff (lambda : ℕ → ℂ) (omega : ℤ → ℂ) (u : Inner) : ℂ := lambda u.1 * omega u.2

moves.declaration: def level (u v : Inner) : ℕ
moves.source_block: def level (u v : Inner) : ℕ := u.1*v.1

moves.declaration: def difference (u v : Inner) : ℤ
moves.source_block: def difference (u v : Inner) : ℤ := u.2*(v.1 : ℤ)-v.2*(u.1 : ℤ)

moves.declaration: def outputY (f : ℤ) (u v : Inner) : ℤ
moves.source_block: def outputY (f : ℤ) (u v : Inner) : ℤ := f*difference u v

moves.declaration: def finiteInnerCarrier (T : Finset ℕ) (H : ℕ) : Finset Inner
moves.source_block: def finiteInnerCarrier (T : Finset ℕ) (H : ℕ) : Finset Inner := T ×ˢ poissonNonzeroFrequencyWindow H

moves.declaration: theorem output_level_pos {u v : Inner} (hu : 0 < u.1) (hv : 0 < v.1) : 0 < level u v
moves.source_block:
theorem output_level_pos {u v : Inner} (hu : 0 < u.1) (hv : 0 < v.1) : 0 < level u v :=
  Nat.mul_pos hu hv

moves.declaration: abbrev Source := ℤ × (Inner × Inner)
moves.source_block: abbrev Source := ℤ × (Inner × Inner)

moves.declaration: abbrev Output := ℕ × ℤ
moves.source_block: abbrev Output := ℕ × ℤ

moves.declaration: def rawCarrier (T : Finset ℕ) (H : ℕ) (F : Finset ℤ) : Finset Source
moves.source_block:
def rawCarrier (T : Finset ℕ) (H : ℕ) (F : Finset ℤ) : Finset Source :=
  F ×ˢ (finiteInnerCarrier T H ×ˢ finiteInnerCarrier T H)

moves.declaration: def carrier (A : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (T : Finset ℕ) (H : ℕ) (F : Finset ℤ) : Finset Source
moves.source_block:
def carrier (A : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (T : Finset ℕ) (H : ℕ) (F : Finset ℤ) : Finset Source :=
  (rawCarrier T H F).filter (fun s => s.1 ≠ 0 ∧ fixedUnit A a s.2.1.1 ∧ fixedUnit A a s.2.2.1)

moves.declaration: def output (s : Source) : Output
moves.source_block: def output (s : Source) : Output := (level s.2.1 s.2.2, outputY s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2)

moves.declaration: def weight (lambda : ℕ → ℂ) (omega : ℤ → ℂ) (s : Source) : ℂ
moves.source_block:
def weight (lambda : ℕ → ℂ) (omega : ℤ → ℂ) (s : Source) : ℂ :=
  atomCoeff lambda omega s.2.1 * star (atomCoeff lambda omega s.2.2)

moves.declaration: def nonzeroSource (U : Finset Source) : Finset Source
moves.source_block: def nonzeroSource (U : Finset Source) : Finset Source := U.filter (fun s => (output s).2 ≠ 0)

moves.declaration: def fiber (U : Finset Source) (zy : Output) : Finset Source
moves.source_block: def fiber (U : Finset Source) (zy : Output) : Finset Source := U.filter (fun s => output s = zy)

moves.declaration: def beta (U : Finset Source) (lambda : ℕ → ℂ) (omega : ℤ → ℂ) (zy : Output) : ℂ
moves.source_block:
def beta (U : Finset Source) (lambda : ℕ → ℂ) (omega : ℤ → ℂ) (zy : Output) : ℂ :=
  ∑ s ∈ fiber U zy, weight lambda omega s

moves.declaration:
theorem weighted_pushforward (U : Finset Source) (lambda : ℕ → ℂ) (omega : ℤ → ℂ)
    (K : Output → ℂ) :
    (∑ s ∈ U, weight lambda omega s * K (output s)) =
      ∑ zy ∈ U.image output, beta U lambda omega zy * K zy
moves.source_block:
theorem weighted_pushforward (U : Finset Source) (lambda : ℕ → ℂ) (omega : ℤ → ℂ)
    (K : Output → ℂ) :
    (∑ s ∈ U, weight lambda omega s * K (output s)) =
      ∑ zy ∈ U.image output, beta U lambda omega zy * K zy := by
  have hf := sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := U) (t := U.image output) (g := output)
    (fun s hs => mem_image_of_mem _ hs) (fun s => weight lambda omega s * K (output s))
  rw [← hf]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro zy hzy
  unfold beta
  rw [sum_mul]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  rw [(mem_filter.mp hs).2]

moves.declaration:
theorem beta_ne_zero_mem_image {U : Finset Source} {lambda : ℕ → ℂ} {omega : ℤ → ℂ}
    {zy : Output} (hb : beta U lambda omega zy ≠ 0) : zy ∈ U.image output
moves.source_block:
theorem beta_ne_zero_mem_image {U : Finset Source} {lambda : ℕ → ℂ} {omega : ℤ → ℂ}
    {zy : Output} (hb : beta U lambda omega zy ≠ 0) : zy ∈ U.image output := by
  by_contra hn
  apply hb
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro s hs
  exact False.elim (hn (mem_image.mpr ⟨s,(mem_filter.mp hs).1,(mem_filter.mp hs).2⟩))

moves.declaration:
private theorem carrier_data {A : ℕ} {a : ℤ} {T : Finset ℕ} {H : ℕ} {F : Finset ℤ}
    {s : Source} (hs : s ∈ carrier A a T H F) :
    s.1 ∈ F ∧ s.2.1 ∈ finiteInnerCarrier T H ∧ s.2.2 ∈ finiteInnerCarrier T H ∧
      s.1 ≠ 0 ∧ fixedUnit A a s.2.1.1 ∧ fixedUnit A a s.2.2.1
moves.source_block:
private theorem carrier_data {A : ℕ} {a : ℤ} {T : Finset ℕ} {H : ℕ} {F : Finset ℤ}
    {s : Source} (hs : s ∈ carrier A a T H F) :
    s.1 ∈ F ∧ s.2.1 ∈ finiteInnerCarrier T H ∧ s.2.2 ∈ finiteInnerCarrier T H ∧
      s.1 ≠ 0 ∧ fixedUnit A a s.2.1.1 ∧ fixedUnit A a s.2.2.1 := by
  obtain ⟨hr,hg⟩ := mem_filter.mp hs
  exact ⟨(mem_product.mp hr).1,(mem_product.mp (mem_product.mp hr).2).1,
    (mem_product.mp (mem_product.mp hr).2).2,hg⟩

moves.declaration:
theorem output_residue_coprime {A : ℕ} {a : ℤ} {T : Finset ℕ} {H : ℕ} {F : Finset ℤ}
    {s : Source} (hs : s ∈ carrier A a T H F) : a.natAbs.Coprime (output s).1
moves.source_block:
theorem output_residue_coprime {A : ℕ} {a : ℤ} {T : Finset ℕ} {H : ℕ} {F : Finset ℤ}
    {s : Source} (hs : s ∈ carrier A a T H F) : a.natAbs.Coprime (output s).1 := by
  have hd := carrier_data hs
  exact output_level_residue_coprime A a hd.2.2.2.2.1 hd.2.2.2.2.2

moves.declaration:
theorem output_positive_level {A : ℕ} {a : ℤ} {T : Finset ℕ} {H : ℕ} {F : Finset ℤ}
    (hT : ∀ t ∈ T, 0 < t) {s : Source} (hs : s ∈ carrier A a T H F) : 0 < (output s).1
moves.source_block:
theorem output_positive_level {A : ℕ} {a : ℤ} {T : Finset ℕ} {H : ℕ} {F : Finset ℤ}
    (hT : ∀ t ∈ T, 0 < t) {s : Source} (hs : s ∈ carrier A a T H F) : 0 < (output s).1 := by
  have hd := carrier_data hs
  exact output_level_pos (hT _ (mem_product.mp hd.2.1).1) (hT _ (mem_product.mp hd.2.2.1).1)

moves.declaration: def rhoPrimaryNu (rho y : ℤ) : ℕ
moves.source_block: def rhoPrimaryNu (rho y : ℤ) : ℕ := supportedPart y.natAbs rho.natAbs

moves.declaration: def rhoPrimaryQuotient (rho y : ℤ) : ℤ
moves.source_block: def rhoPrimaryQuotient (rho y : ℤ) : ℤ := y / (rhoPrimaryNu rho y : ℤ)

moves.declaration: theorem rhoPrimaryNu_pos (rho y : ℤ) : 0 < rhoPrimaryNu rho y
moves.source_block:
theorem rhoPrimaryNu_pos (rho y : ℤ) : 0 < rhoPrimaryNu rho y := by
  exact supportedPart_pos _ _

moves.declaration:
theorem rhoPrimaryNu_dvd_natAbs (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    rhoPrimaryNu rho y ∣ y.natAbs
moves.source_block:
theorem rhoPrimaryNu_dvd_natAbs (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    rhoPrimaryNu rho y ∣ y.natAbs := by
  exact supportedPart_dvd (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hy) _

moves.declaration:
theorem rhoPrimaryNu_dvd (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (rhoPrimaryNu rho y : ℤ) ∣ y
moves.source_block:
theorem rhoPrimaryNu_dvd (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (rhoPrimaryNu rho y : ℤ) ∣ y := by
  exact Int.natCast_dvd.mpr (rhoPrimaryNu_dvd_natAbs rho hy)

moves.declaration:
theorem rhoPrimary_reconstruct (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (rhoPrimaryNu rho y : ℤ) * rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y = y
moves.source_block:
theorem rhoPrimary_reconstruct (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (rhoPrimaryNu rho y : ℤ) * rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y = y := by
  exact Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (rhoPrimaryNu_dvd rho hy)

moves.declaration:
theorem rhoPrimaryQuotient_natAbs (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y).natAbs = coprimePart y.natAbs rho.natAbs
moves.source_block:
theorem rhoPrimaryQuotient_natAbs (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y).natAbs = coprimePart y.natAbs rho.natAbs := by
  unfold rhoPrimaryQuotient
  rw [Int.natAbs_ediv_of_dvd (rhoPrimaryNu_dvd rho hy), Int.natAbs_natCast]
  have hprod : rhoPrimaryNu rho y * coprimePart y.natAbs rho.natAbs = y.natAbs :=
    supportedPart_mul_coprimePart (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hy) _
  calc
    y.natAbs / rhoPrimaryNu rho y =
        (rhoPrimaryNu rho y * coprimePart y.natAbs rho.natAbs) /
          rhoPrimaryNu rho y :=
      congrArg (fun m : ℕ => m / rhoPrimaryNu rho y) hprod.symm
    _ = coprimePart y.natAbs rho.natAbs :=
      Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (rhoPrimaryNu_pos rho y)

moves.declaration:
theorem rhoPrimaryQuotient_coprime (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y).natAbs.Coprime rho.natAbs
moves.source_block:
theorem rhoPrimaryQuotient_coprime (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y).natAbs.Coprime rho.natAbs := by
  rw [rhoPrimaryQuotient_natAbs rho hy]
  exact coprimePart_coprime _ _

moves.declaration:
theorem rhoPrimaryQuotient_ne_zero (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y ≠ 0
moves.source_block:
theorem rhoPrimaryQuotient_ne_zero (rho : ℤ) {y : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y ≠ 0 := by
  intro hn
  have hrec := rhoPrimary_reconstruct rho hy
  rw [hn, mul_zero] at hrec
  exact hy hrec.symm

moves.declaration:
theorem rhoPrimaryNu_prime_support (rho y : ℤ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpn : p ∣ rhoPrimaryNu rho y) : p ∣ rho.natAbs
moves.source_block:
theorem rhoPrimaryNu_prime_support (rho y : ℤ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpn : p ∣ rhoPrimaryNu rho y) : p ∣ rho.natAbs := by
  exact prime_dvd_supportedPart hp hpn

moves.declaration:
theorem rhoPrimary_spec {rho y : ℤ} (_hrho : rho ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    0 < rhoPrimaryNu rho y ∧
      (rhoPrimaryNu rho y : ℤ) ∣ y ∧
      (rhoPrimaryNu rho y : ℤ) * rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y = y ∧
      rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y ≠ 0 ∧
      (rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y).natAbs.Coprime rho.natAbs ∧
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ rhoPrimaryNu rho y → p ∣ rho.natAbs
moves.source_block:
theorem rhoPrimary_spec {rho y : ℤ} (_hrho : rho ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    0 < rhoPrimaryNu rho y ∧
      (rhoPrimaryNu rho y : ℤ) ∣ y ∧
      (rhoPrimaryNu rho y : ℤ) * rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y = y ∧
      rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y ≠ 0 ∧
      (rhoPrimaryQuotient rho y).natAbs.Coprime rho.natAbs ∧
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ rhoPrimaryNu rho y → p ∣ rho.natAbs := by
  exact ⟨rhoPrimaryNu_pos rho y, rhoPrimaryNu_dvd rho hy,
    rhoPrimary_reconstruct rho hy, rhoPrimaryQuotient_ne_zero rho hy,
    rhoPrimaryQuotient_coprime rho hy,
    fun _ hp hpn => rhoPrimaryNu_prime_support rho y hp hpn⟩

moves.declaration: def primaryKeys (rho : ℤ) (U : Finset Source) : Finset ℕ
moves.source_block:
def primaryKeys (rho : ℤ) (U : Finset Source) : Finset ℕ :=
  U.image (fun s => rhoPrimaryNu rho (output s).2)

moves.declaration: def primaryFibre (rho : ℤ) (U : Finset Source) (nu : ℕ) : Finset Source
moves.source_block:
def primaryFibre (rho : ℤ) (U : Finset Source) (nu : ℕ) : Finset Source :=
  U.filter (fun s => rhoPrimaryNu rho (output s).2 = nu)

moves.declaration:
theorem mem_primaryFibre_iff {rho : ℤ} {U : Finset Source} {nu : ℕ} {s : Source} :
    s ∈ primaryFibre rho U nu ↔ s ∈ U ∧ rhoPrimaryNu rho (output s).2 = nu
moves.source_block:
theorem mem_primaryFibre_iff {rho : ℤ} {U : Finset Source} {nu : ℕ} {s : Source} :
    s ∈ primaryFibre rho U nu ↔ s ∈ U ∧ rhoPrimaryNu rho (output s).2 = nu := by
  exact mem_filter

moves.declaration:
theorem source_mem_own_primaryFibre {rho : ℤ} {U : Finset Source} {s : Source}
    (hs : s ∈ U) :
    rhoPrimaryNu rho (output s).2 ∈ primaryKeys rho U ∧
      s ∈ primaryFibre rho U (rhoPrimaryNu rho (output s).2)
moves.source_block:
theorem source_mem_own_primaryFibre {rho : ℤ} {U : Finset Source} {s : Source}
    (hs : s ∈ U) :
    rhoPrimaryNu rho (output s).2 ∈ primaryKeys rho U ∧
      s ∈ primaryFibre rho U (rhoPrimaryNu rho (output s).2) := by
  exact ⟨mem_image_of_mem _ hs, mem_filter.mpr ⟨hs, rfl⟩⟩

theorem primaryFibre_key_unique {rho : ℤ} {U : Finset Source} {nu eta : ℕ}
    {s : Source} (hn : s ∈ primaryFibre rho U nu)
    (he : s ∈ primaryFibre rho U eta) : nu = eta := by
  exact (mem_filter.mp hn).2.symm.trans (mem_filter.mp he).2

moves.declaration:
theorem primaryKeys_pos {rho : ℤ} {U : Finset Source} {nu : ℕ}
    (hn : nu ∈ primaryKeys rho U) : 0 < nu
moves.source_block:
theorem primaryKeys_pos {rho : ℤ} {U : Finset Source} {nu : ℕ}
    (hn : nu ∈ primaryKeys rho U) : 0 < nu := by
  obtain ⟨s, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
  exact rhoPrimaryNu_pos _ _

theorem primaryKeys_prime_support {rho : ℤ} {U : Finset Source} {nu p : ℕ}
    (hn : nu ∈ primaryKeys rho U) (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ nu) :
    p ∣ rho.natAbs := by
  obtain ⟨s, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
  exact rhoPrimaryNu_prime_support _ _ hp hpn

theorem primaryFibre_gate {rho : ℤ} {U : Finset Source}
    (hU : ∀ s ∈ U, (output s).2 ≠ 0) {nu : ℕ} {s : Source}
    (hs : s ∈ primaryFibre rho U nu) :
    (nu : ℤ) ∣ (output s).2 ∧
      ((output s).2 / (nu : ℤ)).natAbs.Coprime rho.natAbs := by
  obtain ⟨hsU, hkey⟩ := mem_filter.mp hs
  have hy := hU s hsU
  constructor
  · simpa only [hkey] using rhoPrimaryNu_dvd rho hy
  · simpa only [rhoPrimaryQuotient, hkey] using rhoPrimaryQuotient_coprime rho hy

moves.declaration:
theorem finite_primary_decomposition (rho : ℤ) (U : Finset Source)
    (F : Source → ℂ) :
    (∑ s ∈ U, F s) =
      ∑ nu ∈ primaryKeys rho U, ∑ s ∈ primaryFibre rho U nu, F s
moves.source_block:
theorem finite_primary_decomposition (rho : ℤ) (U : Finset Source)
    (F : Source → ℂ) :
    (∑ s ∈ U, F s) =
      ∑ nu ∈ primaryKeys rho U, ∑ s ∈ primaryFibre rho U nu, F s := by
  exact (sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := U) (t := primaryKeys rho U)
    (g := fun s => rhoPrimaryNu rho (output s).2)
    (fun s hs => mem_image_of_mem _ hs) F).symm

moves.declaration:
theorem finite_primary_original_modulus (rho : ℤ) (U : Finset Source)
    (hU : ∀ s ∈ U, (output s).2 ≠ 0)
    (lambda : ℕ → ℂ) (omega : ℤ → ℂ) (c : ℕ)
    (K : ℕ → ℤ → ℕ → ℤ → ℂ) :
    (∑ s ∈ U, weight lambda omega s * K c rho (output s).1 (output s).2) =
      ∑ nu ∈ primaryKeys rho U, ∑ s ∈ primaryFibre rho U nu,
        weight lambda omega s * K c rho (output s).1
          ((nu : ℤ) * ((output s).2 / (nu : ℤ)))
moves.source_block:
theorem finite_primary_original_modulus (rho : ℤ) (U : Finset Source)
    (hU : ∀ s ∈ U, (output s).2 ≠ 0)
    (lambda : ℕ → ℂ) (omega : ℤ → ℂ) (c : ℕ)
    (K : ℕ → ℤ → ℕ → ℤ → ℂ) :
    (∑ s ∈ U, weight lambda omega s * K c rho (output s).1 (output s).2) =
      ∑ nu ∈ primaryKeys rho U, ∑ s ∈ primaryFibre rho U nu,
        weight lambda omega s * K c rho (output s).1
          ((nu : ℤ) * ((output s).2 / (nu : ℤ))) := by
  rw [finite_primary_decomposition rho U]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro nu hnu
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (primaryFibre_gate hU hs).1]

private theorem oldformCofactor_dvd (z qf v : ℕ) : oldformCofactor z qf v ∣ z := by
  refine ⟨Nat.gcd (v * qf) z, ?_⟩
  simpa only [oldformCofactor, Nat.mul_comm] using
    (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_right (v * qf) z)).symm

private theorem supportedPart_eq_one_of_coprime {b a : ℕ}
    (hba : b.Coprime a) : supportedPart b a = 1
moves.source_block:
private theorem supportedPart_eq_one_of_coprime {b a : ℕ}
    (hba : b.Coprime a) : supportedPart b a = 1 := by
  unfold supportedPart
  apply Finset.prod_eq_one
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨hpb, hpa⟩ := mem_filter.mp hp
  have hbad : ¬b.Coprime a := Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.mpr
    ⟨p, Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpb, Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpb, hpa⟩
  exact False.elim (hbad hba)

type_digest_convention: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 type value emitted by P34PrimaryArithmeticAudit, without trailing newline. The declaration field is the donor source signature, or the entire one-line abbreviation for inferred types.
private_name_convention: For private declarations qualified_name uses the source namespace spelling. target_name is the actual serialized Lean name; the promoted carrier_data retains its donor statement and body.
